objective: Keep default-branch delivery and dirty-WIP checkpoint authority outside internal kb-work integration
prefetch: Resolve the actual remote default branch in disposable repositories
Read the local, PR, and direct delivery policy defaults and authorities
Test relevant and unrelated dirty-source changes separately
constraints: kb-work never merges or pushes a resolved default branch
Absent delivery policy defaults to local-only
PR manual is recommended for teams but is not auto-enabled by write access
No hidden commit, stash, reset, force push, or branch-protection bypass
acceptance_criteria: Internal integration refuses local and remote default targets
kb-complete owns local, PR, or explicitly authorized direct delivery
Relevant dirty WIP blocks for an explicit checkpoint or shared-serial decision
Local common-dir leases are not claimed as team-wide locks
model_tier_reason: The boundary controls team safety, commit authority, and default-branch mutation
escalation_triggers: kb-work can reach a default branch
Dirty WIP is silently committed or omitted
Local locks are presented as cross-machine coordination
